title: The Origin and Progress of the Mechanical Inventions of James Watt, Volume III: Letters Patent, Specifications and Appendix
lineage: Nineteenth-century published printing of the 1782 patent specification, with plate XVII rendered and visually inspected. It documents historical publication, not the date the Soho hammer ran or the first distribution of the original specification.

passages.note: Printed pp. 76–78 / PDF pp. 113, 115–116, 1782 specification Third Improvement; plate XVII / PDF p. 114, figure 14
